audience: site owners and moderators who run comment sections with Disqus

useCases.title: Catch up on comments on a forum
useCases.text: List the latest comments of a forum or a thread. Ask the assistant for a short summary of what readers say.

useCases.title: Review the threads of a forum
useCases.text: List the threads of a forum and open one to read its details and comments.

useCases.title: Find the most active commenters
useCases.text: List the most active users of a forum and read the profile of one user.

useCases.title: Clear the moderation queue
useCases.text: Read the comments that wait for review. Approve the good ones and mark the spam comments as spam.

useCases.title: Close a thread that gets abuse
useCases.text: Close a thread when a discussion gets out of control. Open it again later.
